title: Blood Serum Stimulates p38-Mediated Proliferation and Changes in Global Gene Expression of Adult Human Cardiac Stem Cells
description: Global transcriptome analysis of blood serum-treated adult human cardiac stem cells shows p38-MAPK mediated changes of proliferation and survival compared with untreated cells Overall design: RNAseq Data of adult human cardiac stem cells treated with young or old male blood serum with 3 biological replicates each and 1 control of untreated cells
